# Coordinate fixture provenance

`coordinate-layout.txt` is the stdout of a Lean program that instantiates the
maintained high-half-first semantics over BLS12-381::Fr.
It contains 20 cases at n=1..5, four seeds per arity, all 60 quadratic rounds,
Boolean sums, and both final MLE values. This is generated by Lean, not by the
Rust implementation under test.

Source SHA-256: `21ddd0c6b286c18430efe4bac36662127d4851bd9d40d77238fd71a7c194d9b4`.
Fixture SHA-256: `c02c08a179a4662bfec0dfd4f51a6c1674fb86f958c828223b1f2af746c65996`.
The fixture is the recorded stdout of that source; rerunning the unchanged
source with Lean 4.33.1 and the compiled imports reproduces it byte for byte.
